title: Concept: ODBC connection string in a response
description: An ODBC connection string in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The string names the driver, the server, the database and the account, and monitoring pages often render the whole DSN including its password field.
applicability: Deployments that render an ODBC connection string into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The string names the driver, the server, the database and the account, and monitoring pages often render the whole DSN including its password field.
